title: 云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 第九十章 佳人云海仙踪 第二卷 更隔蓬山一万重 九十一章 如梦
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
许宣每日除了打坐运气，就是四处转悠，除了设法与那些怪人沟通，找些果腹的食物，也顺便打探周边环境，看看是否有离开这深井般山谷的路径。
然而越是转悠，越是沮丧懊怒。从湖岸到崖壁，偌大的山林与河谷竟似被分割成了许多领地，由众多奇装异服的怪人各自把持，绝不容许外来者贸然进
虽然不清楚这帮怪人的究底，但他们个个真气雄浑，修为远在普通的道门修真之上，言语不通，满怀敌意，不等许宣多问几句就立刻刀剑相加。就算是偷偷摘上一颗野果，也要冒险拼死抢夺，更别说穿过他们的地界，逃离这峭壁环立的山谷了。
到了第三日傍晚，许宣依旧两手空空，一无所获。回到山洞，一整日只吃了两颗果子，后心还险些捱了一刀。越想越是不忿，饥火上冲，憋忍了几日的怒焰也跟着爆发了，咬牙暗想：“罢了罢了就算被这些怪人砍成肉酱，也好过被生生饿死、活活困死”
于是重又跃出山洞，正握紧“龙牙”，环顾四周，思量着去哪儿抢些吃的，忽听南边传来一阵“叮叮当当”的兵刃交加声，夹杂着腔调古怪的叱呵怒吼
林浪起伏，几道人影朝着这儿急速冲来。当先一人绿衣鼓舞，妖娆俏丽，赫然正是小青
许宣又惊又喜，这几天孤身自处，度日如年，重新见到她，当真是说不出的亲切。还不等问她为何回返，她忽然将一个物事远远地凌空抛来，叫道：“小色鬼，接住”
许宣趔趄连退了几步，抄手兜住，才发觉竟然是条活蹦乱跳的银鳞大鱼。那鱼又滑又大，足有三尺来长，猛一挣扎，顿时从他袖里蹦了出来，弹入草丛。他慌忙按住鱼尾，顺势一刀将鱼头硬生生钉在地上。
“咻咻”急响，十几枝箭矢擦着小青身沿破空激啸，接二连三地钉入许宣周围的草地，其中一枝几乎是贴着他的眉沿掠过，连羽没入石隙，嗡嗡直震。
许宣惊出一身冷汗，抬头望去，小青“之”字形地高掠低伏，已冲出了山林，越过河谷。
她身后那六七人纵声长呼，穷追不舍，有的弯弓搭箭，接连不断地破风怒射;有的隔空御剑，银光乱舞，杀得她招架不迭。
许宣大凛，左右打量，抓起几块大石，朝着那几人奋力掷出。他炼了十几日的金丹真，虽只初窥门径，力气却极之强猛。石头“呼呼”激啸，去势如电，瞬间便撞向了那几人的面门。
那些人飞跃闪避，轻轻巧巧便躲了开去。趁着这片刻间隙，小青又荡开两柄飞剑，闪电似的冲掠到了洞前，一把拽起许宣的胳膊，叫道：“小色鬼，你还傻站着于嘛？想投胎做刺猬么？”
话音未落，耳边“嗖嗖”连声，箭矢、长剑贴着他们的肌肤穿入草地。两人低头疾掠，有惊无险地冲入了洞中。
不知是否因为进入了其他怪人的地界，那六七人见他们躲入洞里，便不敢再继续追来，凌空夺回长剑，恨恨地叫骂了一阵，自行散去。
小青探头见他们走远了，松了口长气，靠着石壁坐了下来，道：“小色鬼，快去把鱼洗于净了，烧锅雪白的鱼汤，等我吃饱了，再留些鱼骨残羹给你。
那条大鱼的生命力极强，被“龙牙”贯穿入地，鱼尾仍在猛力地拍打挣扎，撞得鱼鳞横飞。
许宣饿了几日，见到这等美味，早已食指大动，不等小青催促，已将那鱼刮鳞破膛，洗得于净。
没有锅鼎，自然无法煮羹。许宣看那鱼肉细嫩幼滑，少有细刺，想起临安“思海楼”赵大厨的拿手菜，当下用“龙牙”将鱼肉小心翼翼地一片片削下，盛在光滑的石片上;剩下的半条大鱼则用树枝穿过，架在火堆上翻转烧烤。
生鱼片肥腴甘甜，入口即化。许宣、小青两人你夺我抢，转眼间便将百多片鱼肉吃得一于二净。舔着手指，意犹未已，腹中反而更觉饥饿。

眼见那半条烤鱼“”冒油，焦香四溢，小青等不得全熟，便又催着许宣割成两片，狼吞虎咽地吃得精光。直至连鱼刺上的残肉也全都吮食于净后，两人这才心满意足地靠着石壁，坐了下来。
惟有饿极之人，才明白饱腹之后的幸福感。一时之间，血海深仇也罢，得道成仙也好，就连能不能活着离开此地，也仿佛变得虚无缥缈，毫不重要了。
两人靠壁并坐，看着落日熔金，暮色渐沉，明月渐渐照亮了整个山谷，始终一动未动。
许宣似有满肚子的话要说，却又不知从何说起，过了许久，才道：“小青姐姐，你……你怎么又回来了？”
小青脸上忽然晕红泛起，眉梢一扬，欲言又止，转头上上下下打量他，捏着鼻子道：“臭小子，你究竟多少天没洗澡啦？”
content_en:
In addition to meditating for luck every day, Xu Xuan wandered around trying to communicate with those weirdos and find some food to satisfy his hunger. He also explored the surrounding environment to see if there was a way out of this deep well-like valley.
However, the more I wandered around, the more frustrated and angry I became. From the lake shore to the cliff, the huge mountain forests and river valleys seem to be divided into many territories, which are controlled by many strange people in strange clothes. Outsiders are never allowed to enter rashly.
Although it is not clear what the background of this group of weirdos is, they are all powerful in spirit, and their cultivation is far above that of ordinary Taoist cultivation. They cannot understand the language and are full of hostility. They immediately exchanged swords without waiting for Xu Xuan to ask a few questions. Even if they secretly pick a wild fruit, they still have to risk their lives to snatch it, let alone cross their territory and escape from this valley surrounded by cliffs.
By the evening of the third day, Xu Xuan was still empty-handed and found nothing. Back in the cave, I only ate two fruits all day and almost got stabbed in the back. The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. His hunger surged, and the anger he had suppressed for several days also exploded. He gritted his teeth and thought to himself: "That's all, even if I get chopped into pieces by these weirdos, it's better than being starved to death or trapped alive."
So he jumped out of the cave again, holding the "Dragon Teeth" tightly, looking around, thinking about where to grab some food, when suddenly he heard the sound of "dinging, clanging" weapons clashing from the south, mixed with a strange roar.
The forest waves rose and fell, and several figures rushed towards here quickly. The person in front was dressed in green, enchanting and pretty, and it turned out to be Xiao Qing
Xu Xuan was surprised and happy. He had been alone for the past few days, and it felt like years. Seeing her again, it was really indescribably cordial. Before he could ask why she returned, she suddenly threw an object far into the air and shouted: "Little pervert, catch it"
Xu Xuan staggered back a few steps and grabbed it with his hands, only to realize that it was a big, lively, silver-scaled fish. The fish was slippery and big, almost three feet long. With a violent struggle, it jumped out of his sleeve and flew into the grass. He hurriedly held down the fish's tail and nailed the fish's head to the ground with a knife.
"Whoosh!" There was a sharp sound, and more than a dozen arrows whizzed through the air as they brushed against Xiao Qing's body. They were nailed into the grass around Xu Xuan one after another. One of them almost passed by his eyebrow, and even its feathers were buried in the stone gap, buzzing.
Xu Xuan broke out in a cold sweat. He looked up and saw Xiaoqing rushing high and low in a zigzag pattern. He had rushed out of the forest and crossed the river valley.
The six or seven people behind her shouted loudly and chased after her. Some bent their bows and set arrows, and fired furiously one after another;
Xu Xuan was stunned, looked around, grabbed a few big rocks, and threw them at those people. He had been practicing Jin Danzhen for more than ten days, and although he had only just begun to see the inside, his strength was extremely strong. The stone whirred loudly, like lightning, and instantly hit the faces of those people.
Those people jumped to dodge, and dodged away lightly and skillfully. Taking advantage of this moment, Xiao Qing swung two more flying swords, rushed to the front of the cave like lightning, grabbed Xu Xuan's arm, and shouted: "Little pervert, are you still standing there stupidly? Do you want to be reincarnated as a hedgehog?"
Before they finished speaking, there were continuous "swish" sounds in their ears, and arrows and swords penetrated the grass against their skin. The two of them lowered their heads and rushed quickly, rushing into the cave without any danger.
I don't know if it was because they entered the realm of other weirdos. When the six or seven people saw them hiding in the cave, they didn't dare to pursue them anymore. They took back the sword in the air, yelled bitterly for a while, and dispersed on their own.
Xiao Qing looked over and saw that they were gone. He let out a sigh of relief and sat down against the stone wall. He said, "Little pervert, go and wash the fish. Make a pot of snow-white fish soup. When I'm full, I'll leave some fish bone residue for you."
The big fish had extremely strong vitality and was penetrated into the ground by the "dragon's teeth". The fish's tail was still flapping violently and struggling, causing its scales to fly everywhere.
Xu Xuan had been hungry for a few days, and when he saw such delicious food, he had already moved his fingers. Without waiting for Xiaoqing's urging, he had already eaten the fish.Scrape off the scales and break the body, and wash it clean.
Without a pot, it would be impossible to cook soup. Xu Xuan saw that the fish was tender and smooth, with few thorns, and he remembered the specialty dish of Chef Zhao of Lin'an "Sihailou". He carefully cut off the fish piece by piece with "dragon teeth" and served it on smooth stone slices; the remaining half of the big fish was passed through branches with branches and flipped over the fire for barbecue.
The sashimi is plump and sweet and melts in your mouth. Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing fought for each other and ate more than a hundred pieces of fish in the blink of an eye. Licking his fingers, he still felt more hungry.
Seeing that half of the grilled fish "" was leaking oil and the aroma was overflowing, Xiaoqing couldn't wait until it was fully cooked, so she urged Xu Xuan to cut it into two pieces and wolfed it down. After sucking all the remaining meat on the fish bones, the two of them sat down against the stone wall with satisfaction.
Only those who are extremely hungry can understand the feeling of happiness after a full stomach. For a moment, whether it was a blood feud or becoming an immortal, even whether he could leave this place alive seemed to be illusory and unimportant.
The two of them sat against the wall, watching the setting sun molten gold, as the twilight gradually faded, and the bright moon gradually illuminated the entire valley, remaining motionless.
Xu Xuan seemed to have a lot to say, but he didn't know where to start. After a long time, he said: "Sister Xiaoqing, you... why are you back again?"
Xiaoqing's face suddenly flushed, her brows raised, but she hesitated to speak. She turned her head and looked him up and down, pinched her nose and said, "You brat, how many days have you not taken a shower?"
